title: Correct fall time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 8.2 s (or equivalent).

title: Correct board velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 3.3 m/s (or equivalent).

title: Three-stage time analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and calculate the three time intervals: deceleration to rest, acceleration until block detaches, and free-fall time.

title: Friction force calculation
description: Important: The friction force must be correctly calculated using μ(M+m)g when the block is on the board and μMg after it detaches.

title: Acceleration stages
description: Important: The three distinct accelerations of the board (deceleration, leftward acceleration, post-detachment acceleration) must be correctly determined using Newton's second law.

title: Block detachment condition
description: Important: The solution must recognize that the block detaches when the board returns to its original stopping position (9 m displacement to the left).

title: Free-fall kinematics
description: Optional: The free-fall time calculation (t₃ = 0.2 s) using h = ½gt² should be clearly shown.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign handling for forces, accelerations, or velocities (left/right directions).

title: Friction oversight
description: Pitfall: Using incorrect normal force for friction (e.g., forgetting to include the block's mass when it's on the board).
